subject: Emotions
title: Plot Twists and Stories
description: One-minute skill: Plot Twists and Stories.

hook.text: 'I am your father.' Four words that made audiences gasp in 1980. The best stories weaponize surprise.

buildup.text: Aristotle called it 'peripeteia'—a sudden reversal. He argued it's the key to great tragedy and comedy alike.

discovery.text: Good twists feel inevitable in hindsight. The clues were there, but the brain's prediction machine missed them.

twist.text: Spoiler research shows something odd: knowing the twist in advance often increases enjoyment, not decreases it.

climax.text: The surprise isn't really the point. The reframing is. A great twist makes you rethink everything before it.

punchline.text: The best twists don't shock you. They change you.

quiz.question: What did Aristotle call a sudden story reversal?
